headline: Trump 🍊👑 ROASTS PRESS 🍟📰 at WHCA Dinner 🥩💥
text: Donald 🍊👨‍💼 Trump crashed the White House Correspondents' Association dinner 🏛️🍽️ with a roast so SPICY 🌶️🔥 it made CNN 🔥📺 sweat! After April's gunman 🤠🔫 got TACKLED 🏈💥, the press gala moved to the Waldorf Astoria 🏨💅, but the vibe stayed EXTRA AF 💅✨. Trump joked "second time's the charm" 🪄🍆 while reporters from the New York Times 🗞️😤, CNN 📺🤡, and Wall Street Journal 📈💼 got awards for Epstein coverage 🕴️💦. Then the tone SHIFTED like a TikTok trend 😱💃 as he called out "fake news" 📰🤥 and the room's "Trump Derangement Syndrome" 🧠🤪. WHCA boss Weijia Jiang of CBS 📺👩‍💼 vowed the show MUST GO ON 🎭🚂, while Secret Service hero Victor Gonzalez 🦸‍♂️🛡️ got a trophy for stopping the shooter. Trump teased a 2028 cap 🧢📅, joking he'd run a "fourth term" 🗳️😂 despite the 22nd Amendment 🧾🚫, then shook hands with the Epstein team 🤝💰. The room was half-size at 700 guests 👥📉 versus April's 2,000, with tighter security 🔒🛡️ and rifle-toting agents walking the line. Trump ended by praising free speech 🗣️🇺🇸 and saying no "deranged loser" 🔫😵‍💫 would stop the press. As he left, the crowd wondered if the jokes were real or just another Trump mic-drop moment 🎤💥!
